text:
leah: quick sync 1: we need to stop hedging blindly across dedicated/shared pools. proposal: admission + advice split.

mohit: +1. admission should be authoritative for leases. advice can be best-effort for hedging.

leah: admission returns MUST_USE_POOL / REJECT / PROVISIONAL. advice takes (snapshot, tenant_profile, cost_tier) -> recommended_parallelism.

claire: snapshot should be coarse percentage + seq + ts to avoid chatter. e.g. {pool, headroom_pct, seq, ts}. stale if ts older than 1s.

policy-bot: note: decisions must be reproducible in sim. record snapshots with traces.

mohit: DSL primitives: lease_state(tenant), headroom_band(snapshot), allow_cross_region(tenant).

leah: rollout: shadow endpoint -> admission split FF -> canary region -> ramp. metrics: preemptions_after_hedge, hedged_to_shared, wrong_pool_fallbacks, trace_pool_seq.

claire: runtime flags for thresholds live in infra; policy repo holds band->parallelism table. sim binds both to a snapshot.

ops-bot: routers should cache advice 200ms per pool+tenant to reduce latency. tag cache_hit in traces.

mohit: ensure conservative fallback when policy unreachable or snapshot missing: no hedge.

leah: i'll draft RFC with API sketch. action items: @mohit DSL signatures, @claire sim inputs, @leah RFC draft.
